title: Cache & Offline Data
changes: Adds a Cache & Offline Data panel to Settings.
Shows the current Kaishi release, active service-worker state and script, shell cache file count, image cache file count, total cached files and approximate cache size.
Adds a safe Clear cached files option that removes only Kaishi shell/image caches.
Clearing cache does not delete vocabulary progress, streaks, settings, Japan Ready progress or cloud account data.
Adds a Refresh button so cache state can be checked immediately while troubleshooting updates.
Retains the v11.8.37 bonsai sprite fix, Japan Ready quantity counters, Theatre speed controls and Reading-from-Meaning review.
